items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I had met Annie Ross on the seashore, the seashore in Belgium with her aunt

ctx.x: I met Kenny Clarke. He was also married to Annie Ross at one time.
Yes. They… Well, I don’t know if they were married, but he did… they have a child. Yeah, Toby, yeah.
